x;padding:11px 14px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--case),#132f46);color:#fff}.realCaseNo{background:#fff;color:var(--case);font-weight:950;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:9px;font-size:12px}.realCaseTitle{font-weight:950;font-size:20px;line-height:1.05;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.realCaseBody{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px minmax(0,1fr);gap:13px;padding:13px}
.realCasePic img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;display:block;border:1px solid #d9d4ca}.realCaseFacts{margin-top:9px;background:#f7eddc;border:1px solid #ead6b8;border-radius:11px;padding:9px}.realCaseFacts b{display:block;color:#7a3b12;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:5px}.realCaseFacts span{display:block;font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.4;color:#665c52;margin-top:3px}
.realCaseText{font-size:13px;line-height:1.62;color:#2f2b27}.realCaseText strong{color:#101820}.caseWF2{display:inline-block;width:118px;max-width:100%;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid var(--case);background:#fff7e8;border-radius:5px 5px 0 0;padding:4px 6px;margin:1px 3px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:850;color:#27313a}.caseWF2:focus{outline:2px solid #ffc21c;outline-offset:1px}.caseWF2.correct{background:#e5f4eb;border-bottom-color:#4f9866}.caseWF2.wrong{background:#fff0ea;border-bottom-color:#c96b49}
.realCaseActions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:0 12px 14px;background:#f4efe7}.realCaseActions button{border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:11px 15px;font-weight:950;cursor:pointer;background:#0f4a68;color:#fff}.realCaseActions button.secondary{background:#4d7f22}
@media(max-width:1000px){.realCaseGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.realCaseBody{grid-template-columns:140px minmax(0,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:640px){.realCaseBody{grid-template-columns:1fr}.realCasePic{max-width:220px}.realCaseTop h3{font-size:28px}}



/* Homework 24 August */
.homeworkToday{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto}
.hwHeroToday{background:linear-gradient(120deg,#071b27,#123e54);color:#fff;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:16px;box-shadow:0 14px 36px #0002}
.hwHeroToday .hwHeroGrid{display:block}
.hwHeroToday .copy{padding:24px 28px}.hwHeroToday .copy .date{display:inline-block;background:#f4b928;color:#211707;font-weight:950;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:8px;letter-spacing:.05em;font-size:12px}.hwHeroToday h2{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:40px;margin:10px 0 8px}.hwHeroToday p{color:#d6e4ea;line-height:1.55;margin:0}
.hwCaseCompact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 170px;gap:16px;align-items:start}
.hwCaseCompact .casePic{width:170px;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #ddd;box-shadow:0 6px 14px #0001}
.hwTaskBody p{font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.8!important}
@media(max-width:760px){.hwCaseCompact{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hwCaseCompact .casePic{width:150px}}
.hwTask{background:#fffdfa;border:1px solid #ded8cf;border-radius:18px;margin:14px 0;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 8px 22px #0000000d}
.hwTaskHeader{padding:14px 18px;color:#fff;font-weight:950;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px}.hwTaskHeader .num{font-size:12px;background:#ffffff26;border:1px solid #ffffff50;padding:6px 9px;border-radius:8px}.hwTaskHeader .title{font-size:23px}.hwTaskHeader.red{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#b51f25,#781015)}.hwTaskHeader.gold{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#d89108,#a15f05)}.hwTaskHeader.teal{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#087d91,#0b5068)}
.hwTaskBody{padding:18px}.hwTaskBody p{font-size:15px;line-height:2.05;margin:0;color:#302b26}.hwTaskBody .instruction{font-weight:900;color:#0d3042;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:14px}.hwTaskBody img.caseVisual{width:100%;max-height:330px;object-fit:contain;background:#0a1720;border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:14px;display:block}
.hwBlank{display:inline-block;width:150px;max-width:42vw;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid #9b8e80;background:#fffaf1;border-radius:5px 5px 0 0;padding:5px 7px;margin:2px 4px;font:inherit;font-weight:800;color:#21303d}.hwBlank:focus{outline:2px solid #e3ae39;outline-offset:1px}.hwBase{font-weight:900;color:#8a6227;white-space:nowrap}.hwSubmitBar{background:#0b2230;border-radius:16px;padding:16px 18px;color:#fff;margin-top:16px}.hwSubmitBar b{color:#ffd05c}.hwSubmitBar p{margin:6px 0 0;color:#d0dde4;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
@media(max-width:850px){.hwHeroToday .hwHeroGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hwHeroToday h2{font-size:34px}.hwTaskBody p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.9}}
</style>
</head>
